An analysis of the specific holder profile revealed a compromised identity, with 5 of 11 prior transactions confirmed as fraud across closed cases CC-2565, CC-2834, and CC-5521. Examination of recent card activity identified an earlier correlated transaction, 3508487 ($116.96), displaying a high model score of 0.929 and identical match flags M4 M1 and M6 F. The transactions were confirmed as unauthorized fraud totaling $228.88, resulting in a card block and case creation.
